## History

Tommy is a classmate of [Anne](../character/anne.md) Shirley's at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. During a dramatic afternoon in class, he witnesses [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tease [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her hair, leading [Anne](../character/anne.md) to smash her slate over Gilbert's head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) subsequently punishes [Anne](../character/anne.md) by making her stand at the front of the classroom.
